violations.description: The required yellow accent color is not used for the headline emphasis or the CTA.
The headline "MARKET MASTERY AWAITS" is entirely white, but it must be split into a yellow key claim and a white supporting clause.
The "Powered by InteractiveBrokers" sub-lockup in the logo is missing the required small red 'IB' icon.
The logo is placed top-left, but for a square format, it should be centered horizontally at the top.
A subtle node network motif is present in the background, but decorative motifs are explicitly disallowed for this style.
The disclaimer font size (20px) is too small; it should be at least 22px for this banner size.
The disclaimer is placed at the very bottom of the banner, but it must be positioned between the headline/subheadline and the CTA.
The disclaimer text is placed on a colored background band, but it should be directly on the background gradient without a separate band.
The CTA is a white pill button, but for a square banner, it should be a full-width yellow band anchored to the bottom of the canvas.
The banner lacks the required yellow accent color, which should be used for headline emphasis and CTA background.
The "Powered by InteractiveBrokers" lockup within the logo does not include the small red "IB" icon, which is reserved for the IBKR partnership color.
The MEXEM logo is placed top-left (x=61, y=61) instead of centered horizontally at the top for a square format.
The headline "MARKET MASTERY AWAITS" is rendered entirely in white, but it should have a two-color split with the first part in yellow and the rest in white.
The headline is centered, but for a square format (extrapolated from leaderboard), the headline block should be left-aligned.
The subheadline is centered, but for a square format (extrapolated from leaderboard), the text block should be left-aligned.
The disclaimer font size (18px) is too small compared to the recommended sizes (e.g., 22-26px for leaderboard).
The disclaimer is placed below the CTA, but it should always be positioned between the headline block and the CTA.
The disclaimer text is placed on a solid background band (el_disclaimer_band), but it should be rendered directly on the gradient background.
The disclaimer is centered, but for a square format (extrapolated from leaderboard), it should be left-aligned.
The CTA uses a white pill button style, but for a square format (extrapolated from leaderboard), it should be a full-width yellow band anchored to the bottom.
The CTA is positioned in the middle of the canvas (y=555) instead of being anchored to the bottom edge.
The CTA background is white, but it should be yellow (#F5C518) if it were a bottom band.
The banner lacks a device mockup or visual element in the designated visual region, which is expected for this format.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) has a background band (el_disclaimer_band) which is explicitly forbidden; it should be text on the gradient.

The banner uses no yellow accent color, which is the only accent color allowed. The headline (el_headline) is entirely white, but it must always be a two-color split (yellow for the key claim, white for the rest).
The banner uses a diagonal line pattern (el_brand_pattern) which is explicitly forbidden; only a subtle ghost candlestick pattern is optional for portrait.
The "Powered by InteractiveBrokers" sub-lockup below the logo is missing the small red "IB" icon.
The logo block (el_logo and sub-lockup) is positioned too high, starting at y=61 (~3% from top) instead of the recommended ~10-15% of canvas height (y=140 in reference layout).
The headline (el_headline) font size is 104px, which is smaller than the recommended 120-160px for portrait banners.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) font size is 22px, which is smaller than the recommended 28-32px for portrait banners.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) is placed below the CTA, at the very bottom of the banner, instead of between the headline block and the CTA as per reference layout.
The CTA button (el_cta) width is ~87% of canvas width, which is much wider than the recommended ~60% for portrait banners.
The CTA button (el_cta) includes a chevron (right arrow →), but the rule states "No chevron in the portrait example."
The banner is missing the required device mockup in the bottom 25-30% of the canvas for portrait format.
The headline block (el_headline) is positioned too high, starting at y=339 instead of y=400 as per reference layout.
The CTA button (el_cta) is positioned too high, starting at y=1010 instead of y=1180 as per reference layout.
The background color (#004267) does not match the specified primary navy colors (#00122C or #006A97).
The disclaimer band color (#3F6B85) is not part of the approved color palette.
The background (el_background) is a solid color instead of a linear gradient from #00122C to #006A97.
A decorative axis grid motif (el_motif_axis_grid) is present, but the rule states 'No motif' for this style.
The logo (el_logo) is positioned top-left instead of horizontally centered at the top for a square format.
The headline (el_headline) is entirely white, but it must have a two-color split: the first part in yellow and the rest in white.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) font size (20px) is too small; it should be larger, estimated ~28-32px for square/portrait formats.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) is placed at the very bottom of the canvas, below the CTA, instead of between the headline block and the CTA.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) has a background band (el_disclaimer_band), but the rule states it should be just text on the gradient.
The CTA (el_cta) is a white pill button but includes a chevron, which is not allowed for this style.
The CTA (el_cta) is not positioned correctly for a square format; it should be centered horizontally between the headline and disclaimer.
The banner is missing a device mockup in the visual region, which is a key element for visual variety.
The background (el_background) is a solid color (#004267) instead of a linear gradient from #00122C to #006A97.
A grid motif (el_motif_axis_grid) is present, but decorative motifs are generally not allowed for this style, which emphasizes a clean design.
The MEXEM logo (el_logo) is positioned top-left instead of top-center for a square format banner.
The headline (el_headline) is entirely white, but it must be split into two colors (yellow for the key claim, white for the rest).
The headline (el_headline) font size (62px) is smaller than the estimated range of 70-80px for square banners.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) font size (18px) is too small, falling below the minimum recommended sizes for any format (22-32px).
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) is placed at the very bottom of the banner, below the CTA, instead of between the headline block and the CTA.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) is center-aligned, but for a square format, it should be left-aligned to match the headline block (extrapolated from leaderboard rules).
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) has a background band (el_disclaimer_band) behind it, but it should be text directly on the gradient.
The CTA (el_cta) is a white pill button, but for a square format, it should be a full-width yellow band anchored to the bottom of the canvas (extrapolated from leaderboard rules).
The banner is missing a device mockup in the visual region, which is a primary source of visual variety for this style.
The background (el_background) is a solid color (#004267) instead of a linear gradient from #00122C to #006A97.
A decorative grid motif (el_motif_axis_grid) is present, but the brand guidelines require no motifs or patterns.
The logo (el_logo) is positioned too high at y=50 (2.6% from top), instead of the required 10-15% of canvas height for portrait format.
The logo (el_logo) width is 787px, which is larger than the recommended ~700px for portrait format.

The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) font size is 22px, which is smaller than the recommended 28-32px for portrait format.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) is placed below the CTA, but it must be positioned between the headline block and the CTA.

The disclaimer font size (20px) is smaller than the recommended minimums for other banner formats, potentially impacting legibility.

The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) is placed on a solid background band (el_disclaimer_band), which violates the rule that it should be text directly on the gradient.
The product visual (el_visual) is positioned on the left side of the canvas, whereas for this banner style, it should be on the right or at the bottom.
For a square banner, the logo (el_logo) should ideally be centered horizontally at the top, but it is currently aligned to the top-left.
